title: slicer-cli --engine-info
description: The JSON document `--engine-info FILE` prints on stdout (run_info in main.cpp): what the file is and which binary of this package slices it. It is a report, or, with a non-zero exit code, an error. tests/test-complete-slice-path.sh checks every --engine-info document it makes against this schema, so a change to the output must change this file too.

kind.description: The file's last extension, lower case, when it is a model file the engine reads (cli_model_load.cpp kinds()); otherwise unknown.

plates.description: 1 for a model file and for a geometry-only 3MF.

printer_model.description: A 3MF's printer_model, or the model of --printer-preset for a model file. Absent for a model file without --printer-preset.

nozzle_diameter.description: A 3MF's nozzle_diameter, as the file writes it. 3MF only.

maker.description: The app that made a 3MF, from its model metadata. 3MF only.

application.description: The Application metadata, such as BambuStudio-02.08.01.55.

orcaslicer.description: The OrcaSlicer metadata, which OrcaSlicer writes beside Application.

app.description: The app's name: OrcaSlicer, BambuStudio, Snapmaker Orca (slicer_cli-snapmaker only), or the Application text before its first '-'.

this_engine_reads.description: This binary's engine and the file's version. 3MF only.

file_version.description: The version the file was made with. Absent when the file states none.

file_newer_than_engine.description: True when the slice refuses the file as newer than the engine. With file_version only.

engines.description: This binary's engine, then the other one it names (slicer_cli and slicer_cli-orcaslicer name each other; slicer_cli-snapmaker names slicer_cli-orcaslicer), then, from a build that has it, the package's third binary. The first two entries are as earlier builds printed them.

catalog_found.description: The engine's printer profiles are in the package.

has_printer.description: The engine has printer_model; null when the printer is not known.

fits.description: The binaries that slice the file: those with the printer, or, when the printer is not known, those whose profiles are in the package.

recommended.description: The binary to use: the fitting one of the app that made the file (a Snapmaker Orca project: slicer_cli-snapmaker); else, for one of Snapmaker's own printers (the Snapmaker vendor of its profiles), slicer_cli-snapmaker when it fits; else, when the printer is known, the first that fits, slicer_cli-snapmaker only when no other does; else null.

error.description: A non-zero exit code, the official CLI's (Utils.hpp): -3 CLI_FILE_NOTFOUND, -6 CLI_DATA_FILE_ERROR (not a readable model file or 3MF) or -1 CLI_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR (the path cannot be checked). The sentence is the official one for that code, then the reason.
